track.title: Bayat-e Kord
track.notes: Bayat-e Kord is a gushe of Shur (Farhat 1990, p. 33).

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C5 and dwells most on D in Bayat-e Kord. The line peaks at G5 (744.7 Hz) at 3:06.0. It closes on the tonic (Ak4 → G4 → G4 → G4 → C4 → G3).
